brief: Holds one HTTP request as a plain value: method, path, headers, body, query pairs and the path parameters a route bound.
detail: A server builds it from the parsed wire text and a handler reads it. The query string is split off the path at birth, so Path never carries a ?. Header names are matched without regard to case, while query keys and path parameters are matched with their exact case. WantsClose answers the keep-alive question from the protocol and the Connection header.
